properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: This is the Ed25519 signature algorithm which is vulnerable to Shor's algorithm and should be migrated to post-quantum alternatives like ML-DSA. The package uses @noble/ed25519 library that provides EDDSA signatures compliant with RFC8032, FIPS 186-5 & ZIP215.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: This is X25519 key agreement algorithm which is vulnerable to Shor's algorithm and should be migrated to post-quantum alternatives like ML-KEM. The package uses @noble/ed25519 library that provides Curve25519 key exchange functionality.
